rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for supposing something is true without proof.

example.english: I assume he won't come today.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gu2 keoi5 gam1 jat6 m4 wui5 lai4

rows.note: Use this when someone takes on an official position or duty rather than merely guessing or pretending.

example.english: He will assume the role of head of the new department next month.
example.traditional: 佢將於下月擔任新部門主管。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zoeng1 jyu1 haa6 jyut6 daam1 jam6 san1 bou6 mun4 zyu2 gun2

rows.note: Use this for adopting a feigned manner or quality, such as acting indifferent.

example.english: You don't need to assume an indifferent attitude.
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 baan6 m4 zoi6 fu1

rows.note: Use this when someone claims a title or identity without necessarily having the right to it.

example.english: They assume the identity of a doctor, but they actually have no medical licence.
example.traditional: 佢自稱係醫生，但其實冇醫生牌。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zi6 cing1 hai6 ji1 sang1 daan6 kei4 sat6 mou5 ji1 sang1 paai4
